title: A Trial of Corticosteroids for Low Back Pain
brief_summary: Low back pain is a common symptom that functionally disables many people. When the low back pain is accompanied by pain that shoots down the leg, it is felt to be caused by a herniated disc. We are conducting this study to determine if a powerful anti-inflammatory agent will decrease the pain and functional impairment that is associated with this illness.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 21-50 years old, non-traumatic low back pain for one week or less,

Exclusion Criteria:

* fever, pregnancy, lactation, allergy or intolerance to study medication, suspected active oncologic, urologic, or gynecologic disease
